summary_text: Hilton Worldwide stock up 7.1% since recent earnings report; adjusted EPS $2.01 despite slight revenue miss. Launched AI travel planner. Delivered 6.7% net unit growth in 2025, record 520,000 rooms under development. Positioned to benefit from 2026 World Cup, analysts cite growth/competition risks. Indirect subsidiary Hilton Domestic Operating Company offering $1B aggregate principal Senior Notes due 2031. Multiple analysts raised price targets in recent weeks.
